results.title: The 1970s
results.description: You belong in the 1970s — the decade of bell-bottoms, vinyl records, and a radical belief that the world could be made better through community, music, and consciousness. The 70s were raw, political, and brimming with cultural energy. You have a soul that craves authenticity over polish, community over competition, and freedom over security. You would have been front and center at Woodstock (or at least have strong opinions about it), had a record collection that defined your personality, and worn your values on your sleeve — sometimes literally. The 70s gave us punk rock, disco, the environmental movement, and some of the greatest films ever made. They were messy, genuine, and unforgettable. Just like you.

results.title: The 1980s
results.description: You belong in the 1980s — the decade that gave us personal computers, MTV, and the unashamed belief that bigger is always better. You have ambition in your DNA, a flair for the dramatic, and a wardrobe that doesn't believe in playing it safe. The 80s were a time of bold choices, neon excess, and an infectious optimism that the future was going to be spectacular. You would have thrived in the era of power lunches, mix tapes, and video arcades. The 80s gave the world the Walkman, blockbuster films, and the beginning of the digital revolution — all of which you would have embraced with both arms and excellent shoulder pads.
results.shareText: I belong in the 1980s! I took the Which Decade Do You Belong In quiz on ToolNotch.

results.title: The 1990s
results.description: You belong in the 1990s — the decade of flannel, Nirvana, and a healthy skepticism about everything mainstream. The 90s were the last great pre-internet era — a time when subcultures were genuinely underground and authenticity was the highest currency. You have taste that refuses to be dictated by trends, a deep appreciation for things that are slightly weird and completely genuine, and probably a strong opinion about which Nirvana album is the best. The 90s gave us indie film, alternative rock, the early web, and some of the most iconic fashion ever to be ironically re-adopted by the next generation. You were ahead of your time — and the 90s were ahead of theirs.
results.shareText: I belong in the 1990s! I took the Which Decade Do You Belong In quiz on ToolNotch.

results.title: The 2000s
results.description: You belong in the 2000s — the decade of flip phones, peak pop culture, and an era that was simultaneously optimistic and completely unaware of what was coming. The 2000s were fun, chaotic, and brimming with personality. You have an infectious enthusiasm for life, a genuine sense of fun, and an ability to be fully present in the moment without overthinking it. You would have had the best MySpace page in your friend group, known every word to every Destiny's Child song, and owned at least one Von Dutch hat. The 2000s gave us the iPod, reality television, and a cultural moment that will be nostalgically revived for decades. You were part of it — and it was a good time.
results.shareText: I belong in the 2000s! I took the Which Decade Do You Belong In quiz on ToolNotch.

results.title: The 2010s
results.description: You belong in the 2010s — the decade that invented the influencer, the streaming binge, and the deeply sincere belief that brunch is a lifestyle. The 2010s were a remarkable decade of technological acceleration, social awakening, and unprecedented self-expression. You are comfortable with your identity, thoughtful about your impact on the world, and you understand the power of a curated aesthetic. You would have been an early adopter of Instagram, have strong feelings about avocado toast, and have participated in at least one social media discourse that mattered. The 2010s were complicated and fascinating — just like you.
